title: Water Heater Leak in a Finished Basement
summary: A leaking water heater affected several basement rooms. Once the water source was controlled, our team extracted water, removed damaged materials, cleaned the affected areas, and monitored drying until the remaining materials reached drying goals.

title: Hidden Pipe Leak Behind a Kitchen Wall
summary: Water appearing through basement ceiling fixtures led to the discovery of a concealed pinhole plumbing leak behind the kitchen. We used selective demolition to expose affected areas, then completed cleaning and structural drying after the plumber repaired the leak.

title: Hardwood Drying Without Demolition
summary: An HVAC condensate overflow allowed water to migrate beneath a staircase and into engineered hardwood flooring. Our team used targeted drying and moisture monitoring, completing mitigation without removing the flooring.

title: Sewage Backup Cleanup in Bethesda
summary: A sewage backup affected a basement laundry room, including flooring, drywall, trim, and cabinetry. We removed contaminated materials, cleaned and treated exposed surfaces, and used structural drying equipment and HEPA air filtration to complete the mitigation.
